First, convert 43 weeks and 4 days to days:  
43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days  
301 + 4 = 305 days to subtract.

Start date: 1584-12-24 (Gregorian calendar).  
Subtract 305 days:  
Go back 24 days to 1584-11-30.  
Remaining 305 − 24 = 281 days.  
Go back through months of 1584:  
November has 30 days → back to 1584-11-06 after 24 days already done? Let's recalc systematically:

Better:  
From 1584-12-24, subtract 24 days → 1584-11-30.  
305 − 24 = 281 days left.  
From 1584-11-30, subtract 30 days → 1584-10-31. 281 − 30 = 251 left.  
October has 31 days: subtract 31 → 1584-09-30. 251 − 31 = 220 left.  
September has 30 days: subtract 30 → 1584-08-31. 220 − 30 = 190 left.  
August has 31 days: subtract 31 → 1584-07-31. 190 − 31 = 159 left.  
July has 31 days: subtract 31 → 1584-06-30. 159 − 31 = 128 left.  
June has 30 days: subtract 30 → 1584-05-31. 128 − 30 = 98 left.  
May has 31 days: subtract 31 → 1584-04-30. 98 − 31 = 67 left.  
April has 30 days: subtract 30 → 1584-03-31. 67 − 30 = 37 left.  
March has 31 days: subtract 31 → 1584-02-29 (1584 is a leap year). 37 − 31 = 6 left.  
February 1584 has 29 days: subtract 6 days → 1584-02-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1584-02-23
